articles.title: Dario Amodei’s American AI imperialism
articles.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, embodies a troubling vision of American AI supremacy, asserting that only the U.S. and its industry should dictate the future of global AI development, potentially sidelining other nations and raising ethical concerns about technological imperialism. This mindset not only reflects a dangerous hubris but also threatens to exacerbate global inequalities in AI governance and innovation.
